summary: Jiayin Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Ms. Xiaojing Lu as a director and the resignation of Ms. Yifang Xu, effective July 1, 2026. The change is for personal reasons and is part of a routine board refresh. No consideration, premium, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a standard director change disclosure for a foreign private issuer. Watch for any subsequent filings regarding further board composition shifts, but no event-driven catalyst or risk-arb angle exists.
